title: La Silla de Izamal, VISTA STORIES
comment: silla-izamal (VISTA): terraza de una hacienda henequenera en Izamal, Yucatán. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.JACINTO_CERVERA: Mexican hacienda owner from Yucatán, 66 years old, broad shoulders, light-brown skin, thick grey hair combed back, a grey mustache, a white long-sleeve guayabera, cream linen trousers, brown leather shoes, his hands empty.
chars.GRACIELA_CERVERA: Mexican woman, 52 years old, fair skin, black hair in an elegant low bun, red lipstick, pearl earrings, a fitted navy-blue dress, a thin gold watch, nude heels, her hands empty.
chars.OCTAVIO_PENICHE: Mexican man, hacienda administrator, 46 years old, light skin, neat short brown hair with a side part, a trimmed brown beard, a light-grey linen shirt, tan trousers, brown loafers, his hands empty.
chars.CHABELA_CHAN: Mexican Mayan woman from Yucatán, housekeeper and cook of the hacienda, 64 years old, brown skin, grey hair in a long braid, small gold earrings, a white embroidered huipil dress with colorful flower embroidery, sandals, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_HACIENDAIZAMAL: Covered terrace of an old henequen hacienda near Izamal, Yucatán, in the afternoon: mustard-yellow walls, tall stone arches, a tiled floor, a wicker armchair, a hammock, a small wooden table, henequen agave fields and trees beyond the arches, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
